name: Mare Selen El Philizar
original_name: メア・セレン・エル＝フィリアザール
source:
Favorite food: Mushroom, vanilla essence
Disliked food: Dishes with suction cup, kinako powder

The second prince of Serenfaren, Luze's younger brother. His room is full of 2D stuffs. It's hard to see him in person, and his appearance has become an urban legend.
